test_extract_capture_groups: test Series.str.extract() extracts regex capture groups from string data into a DataFrame
test_extractall_multiple_matches: test Series.str.extractall() extracts all regex matches returning one row per match with MultiIndex
test_extract_expand_false: test Series.str.extract() with expand=False returns Series for single group and DataFrame for multiple groups
test_extract_named_groups: test Series.str.extract() uses named capture groups as DataFrame column names
test_extractall_lookarounds: test Series.str.extractall() supports regex lookaround assertions like lookahead and lookbehind
